Package net.maswag.falcaun.verification

Record Class VerificationResult.Counterexample<I>

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.maswag.falcaun.verification.VerificationResult.Counterexample<I>
Type Parameters:
I - the type of the input at each step of the specification
Record Components:
property - the target specification violated by the learned Mealy machine
abstractInput - the abstract input word
hypothesisOutput - the abstract output word of the learned Mealy machine
sutOutput - the abstract output word observed by executing the SUL
confirmed - whether the observed trace of the SUL violates property
witness - the Mealy machine witnessing the violation by the learned Mealy machine
Enclosing class:
VerificationResult<I>
public static record VerificationResult.Counterexample<I>(TemporalLogic<I> property, net.automatalib.word.Word<String> abstractInput, net.automatalib.word.Word<String> hypothesisOutput, net.automatalib.word.Word<String> sutOutput, boolean confirmed, net.automatalib.automaton.transducer.MealyMachine<?,String,?,String> witness) extends Record
A counterexample candidate of a target specification.

The candidate is found by model checking of the learned Mealy machine. Its input is executed on the SUL, and the specification is checked on the observed abstract trace, i.e., the pair of abstractInput and sutOutput, by the same model checker. The candidate is confirmed if the observed trace violates the specification. The observed output may differ from the output of the learned Mealy machine even if the candidate is confirmed (see agreesWithHypothesis()).

    • agreesWithHypothesis

      public boolean agreesWithHypothesis()
      Returns:
      true if and only if the SUL produced the same output as the learned Mealy machine. A disagreement means that the learned Mealy machine is not yet accurate for the input.
